GameName.DefaultText: Harsh Wilds: In the Moon Realm

Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 flag: 1 while you stand in the Moon Realm, 0 everywhere else.

//InMoon: Feature 30 (pack Prompt 43): the PER-REALM presence flag of the Moon Realm. Nothing writes it: BaseValue stays 0 and the realm's CardType 8 location card (hwlocmoonrealm) adds +1 as a PassiveStatEffects value modifier, which the game applies only while that card is in the player's environment. It exists so each realm's own danger (Tgr_HW_MoonGlamour) fires only in its own realm: hw_stat_in_realm is the shared 'in any realm' flag the four raid rolls read, and a danger gated on it alone fired in every realm (found live 2026-10-12: Pixie-Led in the Moon Realm).
